MONITORING TRUSTEE IN CASE M.11577 – EIFFAGE / EQOS



On 28.10.2024 the Commission approved the appointment of:

                  Alcis Advisers GmbH
                   Fasanenstr. 73
               10719 Berlin
              Germany

                  Contacts:
                David Cayet: david.cayet@alcis-advisers.com
                  Dr. Ulrich Puls: ulrich.puls@alcis-advisers.com



as Monitoring Trustee in the above-mentioned case.



The role of the Monitoring Trustee is to monitor the compliance of Eiffage Énergie
Systèmes – Participations (“Eiffage Énergie Systèmes”) with the Commitments attached
to the Commission's Decision of 16.10.2024, and to report to the Commission thereon.

Third parties who have queries in relation to the Commitments may contact the Trustee
through the above contact details.

The foregoing  is without prejudice to the Commission's jurisdiction to oversee the
implementation of the Commitments attached to its Decision.
